name: Regent Bali Canggu
positioning: Oceanside suite and villa resort in Canggu, Bali, designed by WATG, with a private Regent Club, Indonesian and Mediterranean dining and a spa with sauna and ice bath
best_for: Couples wanting a beachfront villa with a private pool steps from the shoreline
Travelers who want club-level privileges and Balinese cultural experiences in Canggu

facts.text: Pura Batu Mejan, a centuries-old sea temple set on black rock, is by Canggu Beach near the resort.
The architecture firm WATG combined Balinese hallmarks with clean, contemporary silhouettes.
The furniture is bespoke and was made by the owner in Surabaya.
Accommodation includes suites with direct lagoon access, two-bedroom penthouses and villas with private pools.
Room bookings include unlimited basic laundry service.
Regent Club access is included for villa and penthouse guests and available as an add-on for suite bookings.
The Regent Club offers all-day dining, premium wines and spirits, afternoon tea and evening cocktails with champagne.
Taru, the resort's signature restaurant, serves reinvented Indonesian dishes with modern techniques alongside international specialties.
Sazón is a Mediterranean restaurant on Batu Bolong led by Chef Andrew Walsh.
CURE bali serves a laidback take on European dining shaped by Asian flavours, by the Canggu coast.
The Beach House has a pool and focuses on craft cocktails and seafood.
The spa's wet areas include a sauna, a vitality pool and an ice bath.

highlights.text: Every room has a solid teak bathtub carved with the masked face of the mythical Barong.
The Beachfront Pool Villa has a private pool and uninterrupted ocean views, just steps from the shoreline.
The arrival pavilion has a seven-layer carving in Javanese paras sandstone.
All suites have a hidden butler's hatch behind a closet door for quiet food and drink delivery.
The Refreshment Gallery's initial stock, including Bali gin, Scotch whisky, beer, jamu and local snacks, is free.

considerations.text: Two-Bedroom Suites are for families with children aged 10 and above.
The resort is not ADA compliant.
WhataHotel notes the popular beach area can be crowded during peak season.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Regent Bali Canggu
